desc: Parse input and separate fixed values and wildcard counts for A and B.
Determine candidate range for target sum S based on min/max of fixed values and non-negativity constraints.
Implement feasibility check for a given S: verify if fixed A values can be matched with fixed B values (complement exists), and remaining wildcards can satisfy remaining slots.
Use binary search or sorted two-pointer approach to efficiently find if any valid S exists, or prove greedy matching works by sorting fixed arrays.
Handle edge cases: all wildcards, no wildcards, and ensure assigned values are non-negative integers.

Implement the complete Python solution based on the ideation: parse input, separate fixed values and wildcards, compute lower_bound and required_matches, handle edge cases (required_matches == 0), compute match_count dictionary for sums of fixed pairs, and output Yes/No.
